entities.summary: Florian "Floriano" Abrahamowicz is an Austrian sedevacantist priest of the Congregation of Mary Immaculate Queen. He was formerly the Prior of the Society of St. Pius X in northeastern Italy, but was expelled from the Society in February 2009 for expressing sedevacantist views.
